Make the switch to Teeccino today and enjoy flavorful, natural energy without the discomfort. Experience the difference for yourself! ☕️✨

Chances are you’ve never heard of Rewilding. So… what is it?

Rewilding is simple! It’s the process of helping nature heal herself by restoring the species and lands it needs to thrive.

Doing so reintroduces the delicate balance and interdependent relationships that make ecosystems thrive.

Successful rewilding programs dramatically increase the amount of carbon stored in soil, vegetation, forests, oceans and marine layers faster and more economically than any other means of carbon sequestration.

March 20th is Global Rewilding Day but rewilding goes on every day, all year long.

introducing the Iced Teeccino Float — a scoop of ice cream floating in chilled dandelion Teeccino. yes really. yes it’s iconic. yes we’ll wait 🤎

the recipe 👇
* fill a glass with ice 🧊
* pour chilled Teeccino Dandelion Passionfruit Peach to ⅔ full
* add 2 oz creamer 🥛
* top with 1 scoop of vanilla ice cream 🍨

optional chaos: whipped cream + chocolate drizzle ✨

fun fact: this is basically an Eiskaffe — the Germans have been sipping this on picturesque summer afternoons for YEARS 🇩🇪

#povtrend #teeccino #teeccinofloat #icedcoffee #summerdrinks

* 2 tbsp coconut cream or oat milk 🥥
* 1–2 tsp honey or maple 🍯
* ice 🧊
* garnish with lemon + fresh mint 🌿

shake, pour over ice, sip in the sun ✨

caffeine-free · gut-loving · basically summer in a glass 🤎
